problem: A governance-only merged obligation could fail terminal closure after all exact-head gates were green because its merge-SHA Brain Foundation push run was cancelled by a newer main commit.
root_cause: Terminal closure treated one specific merge-SHA Brain Foundation run as the only fallback evidence even for non-runtime governance changes.
Concurrent main movement can legitimately cancel that push run although the merge remains contained in current main and other exact-merge Brain verification succeeded.
prevention: For governance-only changes, accept successful exact-merge Whole Brain Canonical Loop v2 or Powerhouse Skill Projection as Brain evidence.
Require current-main containment before accepting descendant governance evidence.
Keep Required and CodeQL exact-head gates mandatory; do not weaken runtime-affecting closure.
